mapper.sql: i.inquiry_id, i.member_id, m.nickname, i.title, i.content, i.status, i.answer, i.answered_by, am.nickname AS answered_by_nickname, i.create_at, DATE_FORMAT(i.create_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS create_at_str, i.answered_at, DATE_FORMAT(i.answered_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS answered_at_str
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM inquiry i LEFT JOIN member m ON i.member_id = m.member_id LEFT JOIN member am ON i.answered_by = am.member_id ORDER BY i.create_at DESC, i.inquiry_id DESC

SELECT
FROM inquiry i LEFT JOIN member m ON i.member_id = m.member_id LEFT JOIN member am ON i.answered_by = am.member_id WHERE i.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY i.create_at DESC, i.inquiry_id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE inquiry SET answer = #{answer}, answered_by = #{answeredBy}, answered_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, status = 'ANSWERED' WHERE inquiry_id = #{inquiryId} AND status = 'PENDING' AND (answer IS NULL OR answer = '')
